description: This file contains abstract test cases for the Device Registration API in the Eclipse Hono project, utilizing JUnit 5 and Vertx for asynchronous testing. It defines tests for asserting device registration status, including success and failure scenarios, with focus on device and gateway relationships.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationApiTests
classes.description: Abstract base class for testing device registration API endpoints, providing common test scenarios and utility methods for handling device and gateway registration assertions.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a RegistrationClient instance for a specific tenant.

methods.name: isGatewayModeSupported
methods.description: Checks if gateway mode is supported in the current environment.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationSucceedsForDevice
methods.description: Tests successful assertion of a device registration.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationSucceedsForDeviceViaGateway
methods.description: Tests successful assertion of a device registration via a gateway.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationFailsForUnknownDevice
methods.description: Tests failure when asserting registration for a non-existent device.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationFailsForNonExistingGateway
methods.description: Tests failure when asserting registration with a non-existing gateway.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationFailsForDisabledGateway
methods.description: Tests failure when asserting registration through a disabled gateway.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationFailsForUnauthorizedGateway
methods.description: Tests failure when asserting registration with a gateway that is not authorized.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationFailsForDisabledDevice
methods.description: Tests failure when asserting registration of a disabled device.
